description: Turn a video file or URL into a set of annotated keyframes plus a written report. Frames are chosen adaptively: one is kept each time the screen changes and then settles, so a long recording of someone reading costs almost nothing while every real UI event is captured. Mouse movement alone never spends a frame. Each frame is annotated with a red dashed box around what changed and a timestamp bar. Returns the report text and one contact sheet image showing the whole video at a glance; open individual frame files (or call get_frames) only for the moments that matter.

include_sheet.description: Return the contact sheet as an image. Default true.

max_frames.description: Hard cap on kept frames. The least informative frames are dropped first.

out_dir.description: Where to write frames, sheets, REPORT.md and manifest.json. Defaults to a .vidin folder next to the video.

profile.description: bug-report (default, balanced) · dense (short clips, catches every twitch) · walkthrough (long recordings, fewer frames) · cheap (smallest context footprint).

sensitivity.description: Percent of the screen that must change to count as an event. Lower catches subtler changes and produces more frames. Default 0.4.

source.description: Path to a local video file, or an http(s) URL (downloaded with yt-dlp).

name: analyze_video
title: Analyze a video into keyframes
